description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

StartupSphere is seeking a Node.js Developer to design, build, and deliver software for millions of users. The role involves maintaining code quality, collaborating on testing and releases, developing Terraform integration tests, and supporting a Laravel stack migration.
Node.js Developer maintaining code quality, developing Terraform integration tests, and supporting Laravel stack migration

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with QA teams to define test coverage and identify regressions early
• Maintain code quality through automated linting, testing, and static analysis
• Identify data-driven Interpersonal Skills regressions in staging before they affect Anchorage customers
• Evaluate existing values-led Interpersonal Skills patterns and recommend cleaner alternatives
• Coordinate releases with stakeholders across Anchorage, Alaska, and remote teams
• Develop Terraform integration tests to identify regressions before releases in Anchorage, Alaska
• Support the migration of StartupSphere's Laravel stack out of the Alaska region before the migration deadline

Requirements:
• 1+ years of relevant experience in technology-related roles
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to distinguish completed work from work that still needs improvement
• Pattern recognition skills developed through multiple technology engagements
• Ability to communicate data-driven insights and translate them into actionable decisions
• At least one year of experience navigating the challenges and stakeholder dynamics associated with technology projects
• Strong sense of ownership and accountability for project outcomes
• Solid understanding of technology best practices and industry standards
• Ability to take initiative and resolve problems independently
